consensus_scope: No public Octra consensus rule changes. Both runs use explicitly activated isolated private genesis; BFT run uses four real validators and canonical QCs. Single run uses signed local history.
limitations: The frozen image predates later host changes for isolated Headscale CLI test builds, macOS-only test helper gating, Rust lint cleanup, and bounded read-only Circle gateway service during canonical publication. It is not byte-identical to the current checkout; the later gateway behavior has a separate focused regression and public-network qualification.
Public devnet funded VPN service, external HTTPS/Tailscale navigation, complete native behavioral parity, and Mainnet readiness are separate gates.
